stages.label: Town plan (2D WFC)
stages.description: Solve the plan lattice with tile WFC, repair street connectivity by traversal, then run a 2D rule pass on the plan.

stages.label: Canals, quays and streets
stages.description: Extrude the plan: dig canals with quay walls, pave streets and plazas, plant courtyards.

stages.label: Houses
stages.description: Raise two narrow houses on every block tile, each with a stepped gable or a roof terrace.

stages.label: Doors and arches
stages.description: Every house opens a door onto a street, quay or plaza; bridges get arches over the water.

stages.label: Rule-driven growth
stages.description: Rules choose the canal-house windows and grow roof gardens.

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: Walk the streets, quays and bridges from the town edge; every house must be reachable.

stages.label: Architectural detailing
stages.description: Courtyard trees, shrubs and street lamps.
